project.name: VexelRay GUI :: Plot
project.description: Reliable graphing: evaluate an expression over a whole column of x at once and get back an enclosure that provably contains every value it takes there. That is what lets a plotted curve be honest about poles and domain gaps instead of aliasing over them. This module is the substrate only — the enclosure algebra and the expression vocabulary that walks onto it. Framing, column classification and rendering are not here yet. See docs/reliable-plotting.md.
